class="docs-prompt-preview" aria-label="Prompt preview" tabindex="0">You&#x27;re Claude Code, working in my repository.

Task
Prepare this repository for Muse Code workflows. Add docs/workflows.md with three request templates written for this repo (a parallel review of its real subsystems, a dependency-upgrade plan, and package updates in isolated worktrees), and scripts/save-workflow.sh &lt;name&gt; &lt;file.js&gt; that checks the name and file the way `muse workflows save` does, then saves at project scope and lists workflows. Don&#x27;t write workflow JavaScript yourself: the request templates are what I&#x27;ll ask Muse Code to author.

Read this first
Meta&#x27;s docs page &quot;Run multi-agent workflows&quot; as Markdown: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/workflows.md
It&#x27;s the source of truth for request and response shapes. The same page for people: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/workflows

Setup
- Muse Code: muse on PATH (install: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | sh, or irm https://dev.meta.ai/install.ps1 | iex on Windows; check: muse --version). Its default model is muse-spark-1.2; --model picks another.
- Auth: muse reads META_API_KEY from the environment (in CI, from the secret store), else a key stored with muse auth set or a browser sign-in; not MODEL_API_KEY. Never hard-code, print or commit the key.
- Python: a plain script that runs muse through subprocess where a step needs it.

Facts to get right
- Workflows need a build with the workflow engine and the WorkflowTool rollout (not the public aarch64-apple-darwin package). /settings, Tools, Workflows: auto, explicit or off.
- Up to 1,000 child tasks per workflow and at most 16 active (CPU-derived); wider batches queue; a 1,001st child fails the run. Each child makes its own model calls.
- `muse workflows save &lt;name&gt; --from &lt;file.js&gt; --scope project|user [--overwrite]`; project scope writes .agents/workflows/&lt;name&gt;.js, so commit it to share. Project wins a name clash with user.
- Names: lowercase letters, digits, periods, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64. Files: regular, nonempty UTF-8, at most 512 KiB; saving doesn&#x27;t parse the JS.
- Workflows load at session start, project ones only in a trusted workspace. After a restart: `muse workflows recover &lt;run-id&gt; --session &lt;session-id&gt; --apply`.

Starter code (Python)
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys

name, file = sys.argv[1], pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
if not re.fullmatch(r&quot;[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}&quot;, name):
    sys.exit(&quot;Bad name: lowercase letters, digits, . _ -, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64.&quot;)
data = file.read_bytes() if file.is_file() else b&quot;&quot;
if not data or len(data) &gt; 512 * 1024:
    sys.exit(f&quot;{file} must be a nonempty file of at most 512 KiB.&quot;)
data.decode(&quot;utf-8&quot;)  # raises on invalid UTF-8
subprocess.run([&quot;muse&quot;, &quot;workflows&quot;, &quot;save&quot;, name, &quot;--from&quot;, str(file), &quot;--scope&quot;, &quot;project&quot;], check=True)
subprocess.run([&quot;muse&quot;, &quot;workflows&quot;, &quot;list&quot;], check=True)

Done when
- scripts/save-workflow.sh refuses &quot;Review Change&quot; and a 600 KiB file, and saves a valid one.
- docs/workflows.md has the three templates with this repo&#x27;s real subsystem and package names.
- The key comes from META_API_KEY or a stored sign-in and never appears in code, logs or commits.</pre><div class="docs-prompt-foot"><span class="docs-prompt-count">3,191<!-- --> class="docs-toc-panel" hidden=""></div></nav></div><p class="docs-p">Use a workflow when one task benefits from several agents working independently or in stages. Muse Code creates the orchestration, runs the child agents, and returns a synthesized result to your session.</p><div class="docs-callout docs-callout-important" role="note"><span class="docs-callout-icon"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8.5" fill="currentColor"></circle><path fill="#fff" d="M9.1 5.2h1.8l-.2 6H9.3z M10 12.6a1.1 1.1 0 1 1 0 2.2 1.1 1.1 0 0 1 0-2.2z"></path></svg></span><div class="docs-callout-body"><p class="docs-callout-title">Workflow availability depends on the build and rollout</p><p class="docs-p">Workflows require a build that includes the workflow script engine and access to the staged <code class="docs-code-inline">WorkflowTool</code> rollout. If either requirement is unavailable, Muse Code omits the Workflow tool and <code class="docs-code-inline">/workflows</code>. The current public <code class="docs-code-inline">aarch64-apple-darwin</code> package does not include <code class="docs-code-inline">workflow-script-engine-v8</code>, so workflows are unavailable in that Apple silicon macOS artifact.</p></div></div><h2 id="start" class="docs-h docs-h2">Start a workflow<a class="docs-anchor" href="#start" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Ask Muse Code to use a workflow and describe how you want the work divided. An explicit request starts the workflow without an extra confirmation:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Use a workflow to review this service. Have separate agents inspect the API design,</span>
<span class="line">security boundaries, and test coverage. Verify the findings, then return one prioritized report.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">You can also describe a large task without naming workflows. When the <strong>Workflows</strong> setting is <code class="docs-code-inline">auto</code>, Muse Code can propose a workflow if the task has enough independent work to justify the added time and token usage.</p><p class="docs-p">Use workflows for work such as:</p><ul class="docs-list"><li><span>Auditing several subsystems in parallel.</span></li><li><span>Comparing independent implementation approaches.</span></li><li><span>Researching a question across several sources, then checking the claims.</span></li><li><span>Splitting a migration into isolated ownership areas.</span></li><li><span>Running an implementation, verification, and synthesis sequence.</span></li></ul><p class="docs-p">Keep a task on the main agent when it is a small edit, a short explanation, or a tightly coupled change that needs one continuous line of reasoning.</p><h2 id="choose" class="docs-h docs-h2">Choose workflows or subagents<a class="docs-anchor" href="#choose" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Both features delegate work to child agents. They provide different levels of control:</p><div class="docs-table" role="group" aria-label="Table" tabindex="0"><table><thead><tr><th>Use</th><th>Choose it when</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><a class="docs-link" href="/docs/muse-code/extending#multi-agent">Subagents</a></td><td>The lead agent needs one or more bounded helpers and can manage them directly.</td></tr><tr><td>Workflows</td><td>The task needs repeatable orchestration, parallel groups, dependent stages, progress phases, or a final synthesis step.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="docs-p">A workflow can call up to 1,000 child tasks over its lifetime. The local active-child limit is CPU-derived and capped at 16. A request-array batch wider than the effective limit queues the remaining work. Attempting a 1,001st child call fails the workflow before that child launches. Each child makes its own model calls, so a broad workflow can use substantially more tokens than a normal turn.</p><h2 id="monitor" class="docs-h docs-h2">Monitor and control a run<a class="docs-anchor" href="#monitor" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Run <code class="docs-code-inline">/workflows</code> to open the workflow control room. The list shows each workflow&#x27;s status, elapsed time, token usage, and child progress.</p><p class="docs-p">Use these controls from the run list:</p><ul class="docs-list"><li><span><strong>Up and Down</strong>, or <strong>J and K</strong>: select a run.</span></li><li><span><strong>Enter</strong> or <strong>Right</strong>: open its phases and child agents.</span></li><li><span><strong>C</strong>: cancel the selected workflow.</span></li><li><span><strong>R</strong>: open the result of a completed workflow.</span></li><li><span><strong>Space</strong> or <strong>Esc</strong>: close the control room.</span></li></ul><p class="docs-p">Inside a workflow, you can pause or resume the run with <strong>P</strong>, skip a selected running child with <strong>X</strong>, and restart a selected running child with <strong>R</strong>. <strong>R</strong> is not a general retry for completed or failed children. Press <strong>Esc</strong> or <strong>Left</strong> to return to the previous level, or <strong>Space</strong> to close the control room from any level. The available action depends on the selected row and its current state.</p><p class="docs-p">The workflow continues in the background. Muse Code delivers its completion to the conversation, so you don&#x27;t need to poll it.</p><h2 id="requests" class="docs-h docs-h2">Structure effective workflow requests<a class="docs-anchor" href="#requests" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Give each child a bounded responsibility and define the final deliverable. This prompt gives Muse Code enough structure while leaving implementation details to the workflow author:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Use a workflow to prepare this repository for the dependency upgrade.</span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line">1. Inspect production call sites and compatibility risks.</span>
<span class="line">2. Inspect tests, build configuration, and release constraints in parallel.</span>
<span class="line">3. Have a verifier challenge every high-risk finding.</span>
<span class="line">4. Synthesize an ordered implementation plan with file references.</span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line">Keep this run read-only.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">For tasks that change files, state whether parallel writers should use isolated worktrees. Isolation gives each child a separate Git worktree and prevents concurrent writes from colliding:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Use a workflow to update these independent packages. Give each writing agent an</span>
<span class="line">isolated worktree, run the package tests, ask each writer to commit its changes,</span>
<span class="line">then summarize the commits for review.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">Keep read-only children in the shared workspace. Worktree isolation follows the same rules as for <a class="docs-link" href="/docs/muse-code/extending#multi-agent">subagents</a>: it requires a Git repository and is never applied as a silent fallback.</p><h2 id="save" class="docs-h docs-h2">Save a reusable workflow<a class="docs-anchor" href="#save" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">Save a JavaScript workflow when your team repeats the same orchestration pattern. Ask Muse Code to author a script from your requirements. You can also provide an existing <code class="docs-code-inline">.js</code> script written for your Muse Code version:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Create review-change.js as a reusable workflow that reviews the current change for</span>
<span class="line">API compatibility, security risks, and missing tests in parallel, then synthesizes</span>
<span class="line">one prioritized report. Keep every child read-only.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">Save it at project scope to write <code class="docs-code-inline">.agents/workflows/review-change.js</code>:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">bash</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="bash" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" style="background-color:transparent;color:var(--docs-syn-fg)" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">muse </span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">workflows</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> save</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> review-change</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> --from</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> ./review-change.js</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> --scope</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> project</span></span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">The save is local. Commit or otherwise share <code class="docs-code-inline">.agents/workflows/review-change.js</code> before another clone can discover it. User-scoped workflows are stored in your Muse Code configuration directory and remain local to your account.</p><p class="docs-p">Before listing project workflows, start Muse Code in the repository and trust the workspace. Then exit the session and run:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">bash</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="bash" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" style="background-color:transparent;color:var(--docs-syn-fg)" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">muse </span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">workflows</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> list</span></span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">A project-scoped and user-scoped workflow can have the same name. Discovery selects the project workflow because project scope has higher precedence.</p><p class="docs-p">Muse Code loads named workflows once when a session starts. Save the workflow before launching the session that will run it. If a session is already open, restart Muse Code after saving. Muse Code loads project workflows after you <a class="docs-link" href="/docs/muse-code/permissions#trust-scopes">trust the workspace</a>. User-scoped workflows remain available across projects.</p><p class="docs-p">Run a saved workflow by asking for it in an interactive session:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">text</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="text" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line">Run the saved review-change workflow against my current changes.</span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">Workflow names can contain lowercase letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens. The first character must be a lowercase letter or digit, and the complete name can contain up to 64 characters.</p><div class="docs-callout docs-callout-note" role="note"><span class="docs-callout-icon"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8.5" fill="currentColor"></circle><path fill="#fff" d="M9.1 8.6h1.8v5.6H9.1z M10 5.3a1.1 1.1 0 1 1 0 2.2 1.1 1.1 0 0 1 0-2.2z"></path></svg></span><div class="docs-callout-body"><p class="docs-callout-title">Authoring constraints</p><p class="docs-p">The source must be a regular, nonempty UTF-8 file no larger than 512 KiB. Saving validates the file and name, but it does not parse or run the JavaScript. Syntax errors appear when the workflow launches. Saving defaults to project scope. A collision at the exact selected destination fails unless you pass <code class="docs-code-inline">--overwrite</code>; the same name may exist in another scope. A completed script must return a JSON-serializable value; <code class="docs-code-inline">undefined</code> and other non-JSON terminal values fail the workflow.</p></div></div><h2 id="recover" class="docs-h docs-h2">Recover and revise a workflow<a class="docs-anchor" href="#recover" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p class="docs-p">In an ordinary retained interactive session, Muse Code persists generated inline JavaScript under the durable workflow directory inside that session&#x27;s retained directory. The Workflow result returns the script as <code class="docs-code-inline">scriptPath</code>. If no workflow session directory is available, including relevant <code class="docs-code-inline">muse --no-session-log</code> sessions, Muse Code falls back to process-lifetime temporary storage. That fallback disappears when the process exits and cannot support retained recovery.</p><p class="docs-p">For same-process editing, wait for the failed workflow owner to stop, edit the returned <code class="docs-code-inline">scriptPath</code>, and call the Workflow tool with that path and the same run&#x27;s <code class="docs-code-inline">resumeFromRunId</code>. The resumed workflow evaluates the script from the top and reuses the longest unchanged prefix of completed child calls.</p><p class="docs-p">For recovery after a process restart, use a workflow-engine-enabled build and the retained session identifiers:</p><div class="docs-code"><div class="docs-code-head"><span class="docs-code-label">bash</span><span class="docs-code-tools"><button type="button" class="docs-copy-btn" aria-label="Copy code" title="Copy code"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></span></button></span></div><div role="group" aria-label="bash" class="docs-code-body"><pre class="shiki docs" style="background-color:transparent;color:var(--docs-syn-fg)" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">muse </span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">workflows</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> recover</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-operator)"> &#x3C;</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">run-i</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">d</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-operator)">></span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> --session</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-operator)"> &#x3C;</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">session-i</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)">d</span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-operator)">></span><span style="color:var(--docs-syn-fg)"> --apply</span></span></code></pre></div></div><p class="docs-p">Restart recovery reads the retained workflow records and script. It reuses committed results and restarts only remaining child work when applicable.</p><p class="docs-p">Wait for the current workflow attempt to finish or fail before you resume it. One workflow owner runs at a time.</p><h2 id="configure" class="docs-h docs-h2">Configure workflow selection<a class="docs-anchor" href="#configure" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1">#</a></h2><p Code removes the workflow tool from the session.</span></li></ul><p class="docs-p">The setting applies immediately to the current session.</p><h2 id="next-steps" class="docs-h docs-h2">Next steps<a repository.

Task
Prepare this repository for Muse Code workflows. Add docs/workflows.md with three request templates written for this repo (a parallel review of its real subsystems, a dependency-upgrade plan, and package updates in isolated worktrees), and scripts/save-workflow.sh &lt;name&gt; &lt;file.js&gt; that checks the name and file the way `muse workflows save` does, then saves at project scope and lists workflows. Don&#x27;t write workflow JavaScript yourself: the request templates are what I&#x27;ll ask Muse Code to author.

Read this first
Meta&#x27;s docs page &quot;Run multi-agent workflows&quot; as Markdown: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/workflows.md
It&#x27;s the source of truth for request and response shapes. The same page for people: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/workflows

Setup
- Muse Code: muse on PATH (install: curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | sh, or irm https://dev.meta.ai/install.ps1 | iex on Windows; check: muse --version). Its default model is muse-spark-1.2; --model picks another.
- Auth: muse reads META_API_KEY from the environment (in CI, from the secret store), else a key stored with muse auth set or a browser sign-in; not MODEL_API_KEY. Never hard-code, print or commit the key.
- Python: a plain script that runs muse through subprocess where a step needs it.

Facts to get right
- Workflows need a build with the workflow engine and the WorkflowTool rollout (not the public aarch64-apple-darwin package). /settings, Tools, Workflows: auto, explicit or off.
- Up to 1,000 child tasks per workflow and at most 16 active (CPU-derived); wider batches queue; a 1,001st child fails the run. Each child makes its own model calls.
- `muse workflows save &lt;name&gt; --from &lt;file.js&gt; --scope project|user [--overwrite]`; project scope writes .agents/workflows/&lt;name&gt;.js, so commit it to share. Project wins a name clash with user.
- Names: lowercase letters, digits, periods, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64. Files: regular, nonempty UTF-8, at most 512 KiB; saving doesn&#x27;t parse the JS.
- Workflows load at session start, project ones only in a trusted workspace. After a restart: `muse workflows recover &lt;run-id&gt; --session &lt;session-id&gt; --apply`.

Starter code (Python)
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys

name, file = sys.argv[1], pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
if not re.fullmatch(r&quot;[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}&quot;, name):
    sys.exit(&quot;Bad name: lowercase letters, digits, . _ -, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64.&quot;)
data = file.read_bytes() if file.is_file() else b&quot;&quot;
if not data or len(data) &gt; 512 * 1024:
    sys.exit(f&quot;{file} must be a nonempty file of at most 512 KiB.&quot;)
data.decode(&quot;utf-8&quot;)  # raises on invalid UTF-8
subprocess.run([&quot;muse&quot;, &quot;workflows&quot;, &quot;save&quot;, name, &quot;--from&quot;, str(file), &quot;--scope&quot;, &quot;project&quot;], check=True)
subprocess.run([&quot;muse&quot;, &quot;workflows&quot;, &quot;list&quot;], check=True)

Done when
- scripts/save-workflow.sh refuses &quot;Review Change&quot; and a 600 KiB file, and saves a valid one.
- docs/workflows.md has the three templates with this repo&#x27;s real subsystem and package names.
- The key comes from META_API_KEY or a stored sign-in and never appears in code, logs or commits.</pre><div class="docs-prompt-foot"><span class="docs-prompt-count">3,191<!-- --> characters</span><button type="button" class="docs-btn docs-btn-primary docs-btn-sm"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span>Copy prompt</span></button></div></div></div><button type="button" class="docs-btn docs-btn-secondary" title="Copy this page as Markdown"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M9 9h10.5v10.5H9z M15 9V5.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 13.5 4h-8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 4 5.5v8A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5.5 15H9"></path></svg><span>Copy page</span></button><a class="docs-btn docs-btn-secondary" href="https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/workflows" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M14 4h6v6 M20 4l-9 9 M18 14v4.5a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5h-11A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 4 18.5v-11A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 5.5 6H10"></path></svg><span>View on dev.meta.ai</span><span class="sr-only"> (opens in a new tab)</span></a><p class="docs-rail-note">Independent concept built on Meta&#x27;s Model API.
